brief: Trim, freshly painted gable-roofed barn about 28 ft by 40 ft in barn-red board-and-batten with crisp white verge boards and door and window casings; a tall white-framed loft window in the gable, a Dutch door and a six-pane window on the gable end, and three hinged plank doors in white frames along the long side. Grey asphalt-shingle roof with a small red louvered cupola with a white cap on the ridge. Wire-and-post goat pens and a few chickens in front; bare oaks behind.
